bottlenecks.operation: Retained snapshot lookup and excessive transport output
bottlenecks.example: Get-Content oracle/startup-snapshot.json -TotalCount 45 read a minified single-line JSON; rg context around 0x14000ac60 also returned many duplicate references.
bottlenecks.timing_scope: Shell execution reported by tool for oversized combined call; model/transport recovery time unknown.
bottlenecks.repeated_calls_or_output: Tool reported original_token_count 7102905 and roughly27MB omitted bytes. Later at least6 focused calls reparsed the291739865-byte fstres snapshot; individual shell times about2.5-3.4seconds. Final bounded negative search read22 snapshots totaling3956574698bytes.
bottlenecks.cause: No small procedure/operation index; minified JSON makes line-based limits ineffective; snapshots repeat inherited evidence.
bottlenecks.proposed_fix: Precompute a read-only index keyed by target hash,procedure,operation and evidence ID. Return existence/count/path plus bounded JSON pointer extracts. Cache a parsed snapshot per analysis process. Provide byte/output caps and never dump whole records by default.

bottlenecks.example: Managed worktree created at C:/Users/alext/.codex/worktrees/chat-b/codex-deform-rea, outside declared writable roots. Normal Git reported cannot come back to cwd:Permission denied; read-only status succeeded with escalation. Writing own analysis files also required escalation.
bottlenecks.timing_scope: End-to-end approval delay unknown. One audit-launch approval review timed out; a single retry succeeded. Initial exec yielded after31.0seconds before later timeout.
bottlenecks.repeated_calls_or_output: One Git retry;one audit launch retry;multiple separate escalated writes for user-authorized deliverables.
bottlenecks.cause: App-created worktree was not added to task sandbox writable roots; approval-review timeout compounded it.
bottlenecks.proposed_fix: Atomically register new managed worktree path with task read/write roots after successful creation. Retain scoped authorization to own worktree;do not expand access to other workers.

bottlenecks.operation: Writing a large contract through a Windows shell command
bottlenecks.example: Single Python here-string assembling contract failed before process creation with Windows error206:filename or extension too long.
bottlenecks.timing_scope: Failed tool returned after3.5seconds;re-authoring/splitting delay not measured.
bottlenecks.repeated_calls_or_output: One failed large command;rewritten as3 smaller JSON construction/update calls. No partial file from failed invocation.
bottlenecks.cause: CreateProcess command-line limit,amplified by shell transport encoding;contract payload should not be transported as one long command.
bottlenecks.proposed_fix: Use a file-write/patch API admitted to the isolated worktree,or stream bounded chunks into a script/data file and invoke it with a short command. Detect encoded command length before dispatch.
